This means we should first make sure we have enough ingredients to craft the required amount of warped planks.

3. Craft 6 warped planks using 2 warped stems (since 4 warped planks require 1 warped stem and we need 6 warped planks).
4. Craft 2 warped trapdoors using 6 warped planks.
